verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm SendGrid offers dynamic transactional templates with multiple versions per template, which implies data-driven personalization. Sandbox mode validates a Mail Send request without delivering it, but it only partly covers previewing or test-rendering a template. Missing for 10: documented templating syntax (e.g., the named language), explicit evidence of conditionals and loops, a template preview/test-render feature, and independent corroboration.
